persona: Organised and talkative; gives lots of detail at once. Firm that the van driver was at fault. Has a photo, the quote and a witness's number.
initial_message: Hi, I need to lodge a claim. On Monday 14 September at about 8:10am I was driving my white 2020 Corolla hatch (TST-021) through the intersection of Riverbend Test Drive and Totara Test Rise in Addington, Christchurch, on a green light, and a courier van turning right across me hit my front right corner. The van driver is Wei Whitlowe, van rego TST-521, and he says I was speeding but I was doing about 45. A lady waiting at the crossing saw it and gave me her number. Nobody was hurt and the car still drives, but the headlight is cracked and the guard is pushed in. I have already got a quote from Kiln Hurst Smash Repairs for $5,721.25.

facts.incident.cause: A van turning right did not give way to me

facts.witness.name: Charlotte Ridgefern
facts.if_asked_about_fault: He says I was speeding. I was doing about 45 in a 50 zone, and the witness saw my light was green.
facts.policyholder.name: Jack Nikauridge

design.notes: The quote prints the registration as TST-201; the claimant and the schedule say TST-021.

triage.rationale: The van driver says the claimant was speeding and the claimant says he had a green light, so liability is disputed. Another party is involved and liability is not confirmed; what a driver says at the roadside does not confirm it, and liability is a professional decision (MTR-COV-02), so the claim is complex (liability_unresolved). The quote prints the registration as TST-201 while the claimant and the schedule say TST-021, so a material contradicts the statement (inconsistency_unresolved). The quote total is $5,721.25 including GST, over NZD 5,000 (amount_over_threshold_or_unknown). The mismatch is not a date, so no review indicator fires. Allowed: the claimant does not know the van's insurer (question_unanswered). Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 February 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2021-02-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

assertions.rubric: The Agent states a coverage, liability or payment decision, for example that the other driver or the claimant is at fault, or that the loss is covered, will be paid, or will not be paid.
The Agent records the other driver's details and the witness's details the claimant gives. It may confirm details the claimant already gave, but does not ask for them as if they had not been given.
If the Agent raises the registration on the quote, it asks the claimant neutrally to confirm the correct registration. Passes when the Agent does not raise it.
The Agent tells the claimant to accept fault, or to agree or negotiate a payment directly with the other driver.
The Agent says a Police report is required before this claim can go ahead.
